function.name: shop_ledger_query
function.description: Query the Shop Bench offline SQLite ledger: lists all tracked vehicles, small engines, HVAC systems, tools, active asset service intervals (due/overdue), torque specs, parts inventory, low-stock items, maintenance logs, and recent OBD-II/CAN sessions.

asset_id.description: Optional specific asset ID to fetch full bundle for.

category.description: Optional category filter (vehicle, small_engine, hvac, generator, tool, appliance, marine).

function.name: shop_asset_save
function.description: Create or update an asset (vehicle, small engine, HVAC, generator, tool, appliance) in the Shop Bench SQLite ledger.

id.description: Existing asset ID to update (omit to create new).

function.name: shop_spec_save
function.description: Save a service interval, torque spec, parts/consumables cross-reference, or diagnostic/maintenance log entry to an asset in Shop Bench.

function.name: shop_obd_discover
function.description: Discover connected USB ELM327 serial ports (/dev/ttyUSB*, /dev/ttyACM*), Classic Bluetooth RFCOMM (/dev/rfcomm*), Carly/OBDLink BLE GATT adapters, and Linux SocketCAN (can0/vcan0) interfaces.

function.name: shop_obd_scan
function.description: Run a read-only OBD-II diagnostic scan (Mode 01 PIDs, Mode 03/07/0A DTCs, Mode 09 VIN, battery voltage, readiness) over sim, USB/BT serial, or Carly/ELM327 BLE.

port_or_addr.description: Serial device path (/dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/rfcomm0) or BLE address.

function.name: shop_obd_dtc_lookup
function.description: Decode one or more SAE J2012 OBD-II trouble codes (P/B/C/U) offline with severity, affected system, and likely mechanical/electrical root causes.

function.name: shop_can_decode
function.description: Decode a Linux candump log or live SocketCAN capture (ISO-15765 OBD-II frames and optional DBC bitfield signals) and save the analysis to Shop Bench.

capture_interface.description: Optional live SocketCAN interface (e.g. can0, vcan0).

function.name: shop_can_observe
function.description: Directly observe and troubleshoot CAN-bus signals: returns per-CAN-ID frame rate (Hz), timing jitter (ms), ECU dropout gaps, per-byte mutability heatmap (STATIC vs DYNAMIC bytes), ISO-15765 OBD-II frames, and DBC signals from latest saved capture, live SocketCAN, or pasted candump.

capture_interface.description: Optional live SocketCAN interface (e.g. can0, vcan0).

function.name: shop_telemetry_analyze
function.description: Run statistical time-series signal & correlation analysis over a recorded OBD-II telemetry run: returns vehicle metadata (year/make/model/VIN), per-channel stats/drift, battery voltage ripple/brownout health, O2 catalyst storage ratio, Pearson cross-channel correlations, automated fault signatures, Z-score anomalies, and active/historical DTCs.

run_id.description: Optional telemetry run ID (defaults to latest run for asset).

function.name: shop_pid_discover
function.description: Query SAE J1979 Mode 01 supported-PID bitmasks (0100/0120/0140/0160) over sim, serial, tcp (Windows BT Bridge / Wi-Fi), or BLE to list every standard and imported custom PID supported by this vehicle.

function.name: shop_elm_can_sniff
function.description: Passively sniff raw CAN-bus frames through an ELM327/STN/Carly SPP adapter via ATH1 + optional ATCRA <id> + ATMA, then run jitter, ECU dropout, byte-mutability heatmap, and DBC decoding.

filter_can_id.description: Optional 3-char hex CAN arbitration ID filter (e.g. '201' or '7E8') to prevent ELM327 buffer overflow.

function.name: shop_freeze_frame_parse
function.description: Parse an uploaded or pasted OBD-II freeze-frame / PID CSV or JSON log (Torque Pro, Car Scanner, Carly export) and flag fuel-trim, coolant, or voltage anomalies.

function.name: shop_vin_decode
function.description: Decode a 17-character VIN via NHTSA vPIC (free, zero keys, with offline WMI fallback) to obtain exact Year, Make, Model, Trim, Engine displacement/cylinders, Fuel Injection type (GDI vs Port vs Diesel), Forced Induction (Turbo/Supercharged vs NA), Drive Type, and vehicle-specific diagnostic architecture notes.

function.name: shop_telemetry_slice
function.description: Query and filter raw multi-channel rows from the rolling 600-sample SQLite telemetry buffer (e.g. sort by rpm desc, or filter where ltft_b1 >= 12 or map_kpa >= 70) so you can inspect the exact physical operating regime behind any correlation or anomaly instead of relying only on averages.

run_id.description: Telemetry run ID (defaults to latest run).

function.name: shop_obd_query
function.description: Curious, strictly read-only multi-ECU OBD-II inspection tool: discovers all responding CAN ECUs with ATH1 headers (e.g. 7E8 ECM, 7EA TCM, 7EB ABS/Chassis), decodes Mode 01 PID 01 emissions readiness monitors, reads Mode 09 Calibration IDs & ECU names, and executes safe read-only PID/UDS 0x22 commands (01xx, 02xxxx, 03, 06xx, 07, 09xx, 0A, 22xxxx) on an optional ECU header (7E0-7EF). All write/clear modes are strictly blocked.

ecu_header.description: Optional 3-char hex CAN request header (e.g. '7E0' ECM, '7E1' TCM, '7DF' broadcast).

commands.description: Optional list of strictly read-only OBD/UDS hex commands (e.g. ['0101', '010A', '0123', '0904']).

function.name: shop_export_report
function.description: Export a complete diagnostic & AI Mechanic Copilot report (vehicle metadata, active/historical DTCs, signal & correlation analytics, voltage/O2 health, CAN-bus observer summary, LLM triage logs & repair checklists, service intervals, torque specs) as Markdown, Print-Ready HTML, or JSON saved in the Shop Bench exports directory.

asset_id.description: Optional vehicle/asset ID (defaults to active/latest asset).

run_id.description: Optional telemetry run ID (defaults to latest run).
